name: Supplier B, an invented plumbing and HVAC wholesaler branch in Round Rock
note: Supplier B does not exist. Its receivers are real businesses from Overture Places, its mix and weights come from Census data, and its volume and hours are assumptions. Read 30 Oct 2026.

hvac_service.source: NAICS 238220 plumbing/HVAC contractors, County Business Patterns 2022: 266 establishments in Williamson County and 345 in Travis (611), split between HVAC and plumbing by Overture's counts in the box (168 and 111 at confidence 0.7 or more). https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/cbp/datasets/2022/cbp22co.zip

plumbing.source: As hvac_service: the plumbing part of NAICS 238220's 611 establishments.

contractor.source: NAICS 236220 commercial building construction, CBP 2022: 79 in Williamson and 216 in Travis (295), split across Overture's contractor (486), building_or_construction_service (201) and building_contractor (9).

orders_per_business_day.source: Assumed from public fleet sizes: Watsco ran 873 vehicles from 695 locations at 31 Dec 2025 (about 1.3 a location, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/105016/000119312526082486/wso-20251231.htm); Ferguson about 5,900 fleet vehicles for 1,519 US branches and its distribution centres (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2011641/000201164125000027/ferg-20250731.htm). Two vehicles at about 20 stops a day each is assumed; no public source gives orders a day for a branch.

weight_lb_quantiles.source: Commodity Flow Survey 2017 public file (CC0), shipments by NAICS 4237 hardware, plumbing and heating wholesalers on their own trucks with a routed distance of 50 miles or less, weighted: 25th, 50th, 75th and 90th percentiles 3, 17, 81 and 318 lb (n = 64,603). The ends (0.5 lb and 1,000 lb) are assumed. https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/cfs/datasets/2017/CFS%202017%20PUF%20CSV.zip

activity_source: Assumed: how unevenly receivers order, as a lognormal spread of order rates. A trade account that orders often is the usual shape; nothing public measures it.
hours_source: The design partner's measured hour of day from Experiment 0, assumed to hold for a plumbing and HVAC counter too.
